messages:
acme_ops: Hey team — during a customer demo today we started seeing 429s and the org credits dropped to 0 about ~1h before our expected monthly refill. We had a promo top-up earlier this month. Can someone check why the reset happened early?

mike_support: Sorry about that — can you paste one of the 429 responses or request IDs? Any header values like X-RateLimit-Remaining or X-RateLimit-Reset helps.

acme_ops: Example response we saw: `HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests` and body: `{"error":"quota_exhausted","message":"monthly credits depleted"}`. We don't have the full header dump but UI was showing 0 credits at 10:12 PDT and our billing cycle is supposed to reset at 11:00 PDT.

jess_ml: Quick question — did you recently merge projects or switch plans? We had a bug where merged subaccounts could inherit the parent anchor and get their reset carried forward.

acme_ops: We did merge two demo subprojects last week (s1 + s2 -> main-demo). We thought billing would align to the main org anchor.

ops_sara: That could explain it — when subaccounts with different billing anchors are merged, the backend keeps the earliest anchor for the combined quota until a manual recalc runs. I'm pulling the tenant audit logs now.

mike_support: In the meantime you can confirm via the admin usage endpoint. Run: ```curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer ADMIN_KEY' 'https://api.redwood.ai/v1/admin/tenants/ACME/usage?range=month'``` look for fields: `month_anchor`, `remaining_credits`, `burst_pool`. If `month_anchor` != expected anchor, that's the cause.

billing_bot: Event: `plan_change` for tenant ACME on 1812250000 merged projects s1,s2 into main-demo; billing_anchor kept from s1 (2026-02-11T18:00Z). Noted.

jess_ml: Confirmed pattern — merged subaccount with earlier anchor consumed credits earlier. Also long-lived streaming sessions can draw from the merged burst pool across project boundaries and accelerate depletion.

acme_ops: That matches: we had a 45min streaming session during the demo. Any temporary fix?

ops_sara: Short-term options: 1) manual top-up via billing console (immediate). 2) We can force a monthly-anchor-recalc for tenant (internal admin action) which will realign reset times to the target anchor; I can queue that now. 3) Kill/expire long streaming sessions (if you want us to do that).

mike_support: If you'd like the recalc, confirm here and we'll schedule it; it will not create extra credits, it only aligns future reset times. Top-up recommended to restore service immediately.

acme_ops: Please do the recalc and we will top-up temporarily. Also can you add a note to docs about merged-project anchor behavior? We almost lost a demo. :disappointed: 

jess_ml: Will open a docs PR and add a small detection in the merge flow to warn users about anchor drift.

ops_sara: Recalc scheduled (ticket #T-8221). I also terminated the active streaming session you flagged. You should see API 200s again once the top-up processes.

mike_support: Follow-up: to debug similar issues in future check `/v1/account/usage` for the calling project and `/v1/admin/tenants/:id/usage` for org-level numbers; watch `month_anchor` and `burst_pool` fields. If you can paste a case ID we can link logs.

acme_ops: Thanks all — top-up processed and tests look good. We'll monitor and review the merge docs. Much appreciated :thumbsup:
